quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce Holdings Plc 2026 Half Year Results (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Power Systems (H1 2026 release): the next-generation engine will offer a 20% higher power density than the current Series 4000 engine, remains on track to launch in 2028, and full system testing has started in the US facility. Battery energy storage: in March construction began on an 86MWh energy storage project in Falkirk, Scotland for Voltaria Helios Energy Storage, to connect to the grid later this year; in June Rolls-Royce signed contracts with Sunly for four large-scale BESS in Latvia with a total capacity of 490MWh.
quarterly_data.figure: next-generation engine 20% higher power density, launch 2028; 86MWh Falkirk; 490MWh Latvia

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce Holdings Plc 2026 Half Year Results (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Power Systems governmental (H1 2026 release): Rolls-Royce will supply 350 upgraded mtu Series 199 engines for new Boxer armoured wheeled vehicles for the German Armed Forces and other international customers, secured an order for around 200 compact mtu PowerPacks for the Puma armoured personnel carrier, and signed a memorandum of understanding with Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa S.A. to provide services to mtu engines used by the Polish Armed Forces; governmental order intake was strong in the half.
quarterly_data.figure: 350 mtu Series 199 engines; around 200 mtu PowerPacks

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce Holdings Plc 2026 Half Year Results (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Civil Aerospace operations (H1 2026 release): gross contractual margin improvements of GBP 574m in the period; large engine MRO output up 13%; the time-on-wing programme targets more than a 100% durability increase across in-production engines by the end of 2027, with the majority now delivered; almost 50% of the Trent 1000 TEN fleet fitted with improved HPT blades (XE standard) and almost the entire Trent 7000 fleet upgraded; remaining Trent XWB-84 LLP life extensions on track for certification by year end; Trent XWB-97 combustor and ceramic matrix composite seal segment completed TRL 6; the Trent XWB-84 EP, in service with Delta Air Lines, delivers a 1.8% specific fuel efficiency improvement against a 1% target; the Pearl 10X powered the first flight of Dassault's Falcon 10X; aircraft on ground effectively eliminated; Turkish Technic broke ground on an engine maintenance centre at Istanbul Airport targeted to be operational by the end of 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: gross contractual margin improvements GBP 574m; large engine MRO output +13%; XWB-84 EP 1.8% fuel efficiency gain

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce Holdings Plc 2026 Half Year Results (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 guidance detail in the H1 release: Rolls-Royce continues to expect 550-600 total OE deliveries and 1,480-1,550 total shop visits, and expects a lower contribution from contractual margin improvements in Civil Aerospace in the second half (H1 2026: GBP 497m); the GBP 150-200m aerospace supply chain cash impact in 2026 free cash flow guidance is expected to be gone by the mid-term, with a reduced outflow in 2027.
